summary: This outlines the general steps involved in collecting student fees, from viewing student details and fee demands to applying concessions and selecting payment installments.
steps: Search for and select the student from whom fees are to be collected.
The student's fee collection section will open, displaying their personal details and fee demand.
Review the total fees, any applied concessions, and the final payable amount.
Select the desired installments for payment (e.g., first installment, all installments, or a custom amount).
Proceed to the payment section to finalize the collection.
business_rules: Fee demand is determined by the student's course and academic year.
Concessions, if applicable, will reduce the payable amount.
Users can choose to collect specific installments or the total outstanding amount.
The system automatically selects the current installment based on the due date.
important_notes: Users have the flexibility to manually enter a custom payment amount if a student is not paying the full installment amount.
questions: What are the steps to collect fees from a student?
How can I view a student's total fee demand and payable amount?

How does the system handle fee installments during collection?
